summary.goal: Strive where it's safe, protect what isn't. Bench, pull-up and dip push hard; squat holds under the injection cap with a W3 clearance gate; sumo is demoted to a technical skill lift with no PR intent.
changes: Sumo is a SKILL LIFT this block, not a strength lift — fixed 345–365 band, crisp triples, 405 not in play. No autoregulating up. Athlete's call, and the right one.
Squat runs the CAPPED track by default (455–465 @7.5). W3–W4 release to 465×3 / 480×2 @8 ONLY on doctor clearance for heavy axial load — ask at the Aug 14 visit.
Comp bench W4 is written as a RANGE with 'work up to @8' (255–270×2) — B4's fix. You peaked at @6 against an @8 allowance last block; the cap is a target to find.
Pull-up keeps the hard @8 cap (it worked) but now earns load: BW+70 → BW+85.
Dip peaks W3 at BW+90×4 @8, pulls back W4 so it doesn't stack with the bench peak.
Paused RDL load CUT ~40 lb (265–275 → 225–245, @7 cap). A heavy second hinge on D2 contradicts a back-conservative block.

Shoulder MRI read 2026-08-07: low-grade partial-thickness supraspinatus + subscapularis tears, NO full-thickness, NO fatty atrophy, labrum/biceps intact, plus mild AC degeneration and subacromial bursitis. Net reassuring — bench numbers unchanged. The bursitis/AC finding makes DIP DEPTH the primary dip variable and justifies the @7 overhead cap.
accessory_changes: NEW: Chest Supported Incline Row (D4) — replaces Meadows Row. Same upper-back target, zero lumbar load on your deadlift day. Expands mid-back without loading the spine.
RE-INTRODUCED: Weighted Back Extension (D4) — your request. Erector capacity with no spinal compression. Starting 45 lb, not 90; the injections still mask pain.
SECONDARY ROTATION (1): squat 3-1-0 Tempo → Paused Low-bar Squat. Bench (Spoto) and deadlift (Paused RDL) secondaries HELD — Spoto is mid-progress, Paused RDL grooves the hitch fix.
OUT: Iso-Lateral Row — you logged it 1/4 in B4, and on D1 it pre-fatigued Tuesday's pull-up (day-interference violation). Mid-back volume now comes from D3/D4.
OUT: Hip Adduction — flat at 115 for months, and adductors on D3 pre-fatigue Friday sumo.
MOVED: Face Pull D4 → D3, so the shoulder-health cluster sits on dip day and D3 carries nothing that pre-fatigues Friday's sumo.
RE-ANCHORED from the log (sheet-load-sync): Leg Extension 90→140, Reverse Pec Deck 45→100, DB Shoulder Press 50→70, Concentration Curl 25→43, Incline DB Press 50→65.
